item.title: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources announce 2025 Buck Firearm Season harvest numbers
item.description: Charleston, WV (WOAY) The West Virginia Division of Natural Resources (WVDNR) has released the harvest numbers from this year’s Buck Firearm Season. Hunters harvested 33,775 antlered deer between November 24th and December 7. Greenbrier County brought in the most bucks according to preliminary data through the DNR’s electronic game check system, with 1,730. item.title: WVDNR highlights additional deer hunting opportunities following end of Buck Firearms Season
item.description: Charleston, WV (WOAY) While the Buck Firearms Season is over, there are still several opportunities to hunt deer.
